stock.description: Ming Fai International Holdings Limited operates as an investment holding company that specializes in providing a comprehensive range of supplies to the hospitality industry. It manufactures and distributes these products, while also trading in essential operating equipment across a vast international network, including Hong Kong, North America, Europe, mainland China, Australia, and other regions within Asia Pacific and globally. The company's extensive product portfolio caters to various hotel needs. For guest rooms, offerings include bath mats, a diverse array of acrylic, leather, and resin hotel amenities, portable charging cables, umbrellas, and compact mirrors. Electronic provisions for rooms feature safe deposit boxes, digital scales, flashlights, mini-refrigerators, electric kettles, telephones, hair dryers/irons, and digital clocks. For public areas, Ming Fai supplies lobby equipment comprising message boards, signage, luggage and housekeeping trolleys, hotel railing stands, ashtrays, outdoor refuse bins, podiums, and various stands for umbrellas, luggage, garments, and hats, alongside beverage carts. Janitorial needs are met with a selection of cleaning tools, equipment, waste receptacles, and detergents. Furthermore, their offerings extend to food and beverage items, such as glassware and a wide assortment of kitchenware, including Western dining sets, cutlery, buffet collections, and kitchen appliances. Melamine tableware and childcare cribs are also available. The company provides a full suite of bathroom and linen provisions, encompassing dispensers, bath products, towels, bedding, table linens, footwear, bathrobes, accessories, and mattresses. A significant portion of their inventory is dedicated to ceramics and porcelain, featuring general collections, plates, bowls, soup tureens, coffee and tea sets, color-glazed and specialized Japanese/Korean porcelain, sand and stone pots, and coarse pottery. Founded in 1980, Ming Fai International Holdings Limited maintains its headquarters in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong.
